ENUM Kind
VALUE MOBILE 0
VALUE HOME 1
VALUE WORK 2
END
MESSAGE Phone
FIELD 1 string number REQUIRED
FIELD 2 Kind kind
END
MESSAGE Person
FIELD 2 string name
FIELD 1 uint32 id REQUIRED
FIELD 4 Phone phones REPEATED
FIELD 5 uint32 tags REPEATED PACKED
FIELD 6 Person friend
FIELD 7 bytes avatar
FIELD 8 bool active
FIELD 11 Phone backup_phone ONEOF contact
FIELD 10 string home_page ONEOF contact
FIELD 12 sint32 delta
END
ENUM Level
VALUE HIGH 100
VALUE LOW 1
VALUE MID 5
VALUE TOP 1000000
END
MESSAGE Scalars
FIELD 1 uint32 u32
FIELD 2 uint64 u64
FIELD 3 sint32 s32
FIELD 4 sint64 s64
FIELD 5 bool flag
FIELD 6 fixed32 f32
FIELD 7 sfixed32 sf32
FIELD 8 fixed64 f64
FIELD 9 string text
FIELD 10 bytes blob
FIELD 11 Level level
END
MESSAGE Lists
FIELD 1 sint64 values REPEATED PACKED
FIELD 2 fixed32 words REPEATED PACKED
FIELD 3 Level levels REPEATED
FIELD 4 bool bits REPEATED PACKED
FIELD 5 string names REPEATED
FIELD 6 fixed64 stamps REPEATED
FIELD 7 sfixed32 offsets REPEATED PACKED
FIELD 8 bytes chunks REPEATED
FIELD 9 Kind kinds REPEATED PACKED
FIELD 10 uint64 counts REPEATED
FIELD 11 fixed64 marks REPEATED PACKED
END
MESSAGE Node
FIELD 1 sint32 value
FIELD 2 Node children REPEATED
FIELD 3 Branch branch
END
MESSAGE Branch
FIELD 2 Node node
FIELD 1 string label
END
MESSAGE Empty
END
MESSAGE Range
FIELD 3 sint64 hi REQUIRED
FIELD 2 sint64 lo REQUIRED
FIELD 1 Range inner
END
MESSAGE Envelope
FIELD 536870911 bool last
FIELD 1 uint64 seq REQUIRED
FIELD 3 Person sender
FIELD 4 Scalars scalars ONEOF body
FIELD 5 Lists lists ONEOF body
FIELD 6 string note ONEOF body
FIELD 7 Empty marker
FIELD 9 Node tree
FIELD 20 fixed64 stamp
FIELD 16 string line_2
END
END SCHEMA
